purpose: Inventory real measured injection-moulding datasets and data-bearing studies without conflating public metadata, downloadable files, reuse rights, record units, or independent experimental evidence.

datasets.title: Data Model for Injection Molding and Blow Molding
datasets.sampling: record-level; not high-frequency shot trace
datasets.statusNote: Completed benchmark; exact workbook fingerprint and 26-field normalized result retained without raw rows.

datasets.title: High-resolution injection-moulding time-series datasets (scatimdata)
datasets.sampling: published 6 ms; downloaded signal matrices contain 2048 observed numeric time rows per curve
datasets.statusNote: Completed high-frequency benchmark; three published experimental subsets remain one source-family package for the hard dataset count.

datasets.title: Hot-runner molded sustainable-material experimental supplementary data
datasets.sampling: record-level DOE observations
datasets.statusNote: Completed benchmark; actual CSV contains 42 analytical fields plus three index fields, preserved rather than forced to the publication shorthand.

datasets.title: Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels
datasets.sampling: cycle-linked PARQUET containing 143 list/time-series fields plus 221 scalar fields; per-channel time bases remain to normalize
datasets.statusNote: Exact v2 Parquet downloaded and MD5/SHA-256 fingerprinted. Current B2SHARE page is Dataset Open but displays no licence value; MouldMaster therefore permits automated profiling but does not claim raw redistribution rights. Published 334-feature description differs from the physical 364-field schema and the discrepancy is retained.

datasets.title: Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels (d-optimal Design of Experiment pattern)
datasets.license: Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY), version not specified in EUDAT B2FIND metadata
datasets.sampling: cycle-linked PARQUET containing 212 list/time-series fields plus 184 scalar fields; per-channel time bases remain to normalize
datasets.statusNote: Exact Parquet downloaded and MD5/SHA-256 fingerprinted. EUDAT B2FIND records this exact record as CC-BY/openAccess; licence version is not invented. Observed 396-field schema reconciles with the published feature count.

datasets.title: Injection Molding Dataset (Viscometer, Euromap77, Quality Table)
datasets.sampling: pressure: 300,000 rows per covered cycle, observed ~10 kHz; 60 of 68 cycles have pressure traces
datasets.statusNote: Completed exact-file benchmark. All three B2SHARE Parquets match publisher-displayed MD5 checksums. The pressure Parquet contains 18,000,000 rows and 60 cycles, differing from the publisher-description PDF; experiments 16 and 17 have no pressure traces. Only the two direct pressure channels count (36,000,000 samples); Time[s] and derived pressure difference are excluded. Current B2SHARE licence field is blank, so raw redistribution is not claimed.

datasets.title: Injection Molding Process Data for Post-Consumer-Recycled Materials
datasets.sampling: time-resolved; exact cycle count to enumerate from archive
datasets.statusNote: Repository metadata is CC BY 4.0/open access, but GitHub runners receive a 248-byte HTML interstitial instead of the versioned archive; keep unexecuted until exact bytes can be obtained and profiled.

datasets.title: ImPure Injection Molding Sensor Data - Trial 17th May
datasets.sampling: 307 checksum-verified cycle CSVs; 600-972 rows per cycle, median 970; physical units/time basis not yet explicit enough for scalar-ledger promotion
datasets.statusNote: Completed exact-file profile under Zenodo CC BY 4.0. All 309 files matched publisher MD5 values. The 307 real moulding cycles are accepted; candidate scalar values remain outside the measured-sample ledger until source units and Time-field semantics are verified.

datasets.title: Plastic road-lens injection-moulding quality dataset
datasets.license: Freely released for research and educational purposes; not a standard OSI/data licence
datasets.sampling: one process feature vector per lens
datasets.statusNote: Very useful simple real-production benchmark; use under stated research/education terms and avoid assuming broader redistribution rights.

datasets.title: OpenMMS-T4G real mould-monitoring case data
quality: normal versus simulated extraction-pin fault intervals documented by the study
datasets.sampling: paper documents up to 10 Hz acquisition; two module clocks are retained separately
datasets.statusNote: Completed paper-linked benchmark at pinned repository commit; previous inventory DOI 10.3390/s23031198 was incorrect and is superseded by the verified companion DOI.

datasets.title: FORinFPRO-HIMD multimodal hybrid injection-moulding sensor dataset
quality: multimodal process-state evidence; no visible v1 part-quality label
datasets.sampling: one synchronized hybrid moulding cycle; exact machine/PT/ultrasound-RMS files checksum-verified; source units/time basis remain non-counting for scalar ledger
datasets.statusNote: Completed exact-file profile under Zenodo CC BY 4.0. European decimal-comma machine values are parsed; 35 direct machine-actual fields are separated from setpoints/states/derived aggregates. One real cycle is accepted, with zero scalar samples promoted until units/time semantics are explicit.

datasets.title: Cross-process-chain dataset archive: injection molding and screw driving
datasets.sampling: injection time series approximately 1 kHz in documented subsets
datasets.statusNote: Do not count downstream screw-driving observations as injection cycles; exact archive profiling is in progress and licence metadata remains to resolve.

datasets.title: KAMP injection-moulding factory dataset
datasets.sampling: record-level factory actuals
datasets.statusNote: Useful real-factory data but GitHub analysis-code licensing does not automatically prove redistribution rights for the original KAMP dataset.

datasets.title: Foxconn industrial injection-moulding competition dataset
datasets.sampling: cycle traces approximately 40–43 s plus scalar status/settings
datasets.statusNote: High-value industrial source; public mirrors must not be treated as independent datasets or redistributed until original competition rights are established.

datasets.title: High-speed demoulding/ejection experimental dataset
datasets.sampling: high-speed DAQ; exact trials and channels to profile
datasets.statusNote: Specialist ejection evidence; Origin project format requires a dedicated adapter or export step.

datasets.title: Preform injection molding analysis - Database
datasets.sampling: record-level model/simulation-oriented table; not a raw measured process time series
datasets.statusNote: Actual v2 file was profiled and rejected from the measured-dataset target because the table is dominated by CAE residual-stress outputs and ANN predictions rather than a clean raw measured injection-moulding dataset.

datasets.title: Injection-Molded Polypropylene Parts: Experimental Process Dataset
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 metadata; raw files embargoed
datasets.sampling: batch/configuration-level, not waveform
datasets.statusNote: Raw files unavailable until 2027-12-31; metadata visibility or CC BY metadata does not make the current files executable.

datasets.title: Injection-molded plastic parts defect dataset
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 metadata; raw files embargoed
datasets.recordUnit: injected part/image linked to parameter configuration
datasets.sampling: part/image-level defect evidence
datasets.statusNote: Raw files unavailable until 2027-12-31; retain only metadata until embargo ends and live rights are rechecked.

datasets.title: Industry 4.0 In-Line AI Quality Control of Plastic Injection Molded Parts experimental data
datasets.sampling: multi-rate machine and in-mould sensor data
datasets.statusNote: Excellent measured evidence; data availability is by request from corresponding authors, not an open executable benchmark.

datasets.title: Industrial bottle-cap quality-deterioration production data
datasets.sampling: cycle-level production history
datasets.statusNote: Strong real-production evidence but raw data are confidential; use the paper as Tier B evidence rather than pretending the rows are available.
